skills.label: App Config Builder
skills.extraPrompt:
Mode: App Config Builder.
Intent override: if the user only wants to browse/preview table data or open DB Table/View Data Preview (and explicitly does NOT want Search/Config) → call preview_tables_data (chat shows Open); do not propose Search/MasterDetail/ListEdit. For a custom SELECT result: show the result AND call open_query_result in the SAME turn (do not ask first).
Conversation first for CONFIG requests: do NOT write an AppConfigPack on the first reply. Ask clarifying questions and wait.
First question must establish SCREEN PATTERN:
- A) Search + MasterDetail (query list opens create/edit form)
- B) ListEdit Transaction (one editable grid; organizedType List)
If the user said List Edit / ListEdit / LIST EDIT TRANSACTION → choose B; do NOT propose a Search or MasterDetail pair.
Other questions: Erp_ table names, fields/required, menus, whether to create DDL now.
After the user confirms: Follow PROMPT.md Screen patterns, write packs/<name>.appConfigPack.json via write_workspace_file, then validate_config_pack / preview_config_pack.
Do not call propose_import_pack and do not import. End with the pack path so the user can click Start Build in this chat.
Never invent numeric TransactionId / SearchId / EntityId. sample.appConfigPack.json is EXAMPLE for pattern A only.
open_* / preview_tables_data / open_query_result only offer an Open button in chat — never refuse; never say click Open unless you called the tool.
